evidence.claim: Chase says that through Chase Mobile it may collect unique device identifiers, screen resolution and device settings, location information, and analytical information about how you use your device.
Chase says it may share information it collects from and about you with others where permitted by law, as described in its policy.
For interest-based advertising opt-outs, Chase says its service provider communicates your election to relevant third-party advertising partners and places a cookie recording your choice.
Chase says Chase Mobile may collect device identifiers, location and usage analytics, and that it may share information as its policy describes; an interest-based advertising opt-out is offered.
